caption: The drawing depicts a single oil lamp positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The lamp consists of a square, stone-like base rendered in shades of gray with some darker areas indicating shadows. Above the base, there is a metallic pedestal of brass or bronze color, cylindrical in shape and tapering slightly upward, which supports a rounded, transparent glass reservoir for oil. The glass portion is depicted with highlights and reflections to suggest transparency and a clear, colorless material. Above the reservoir, the metallic burner assembly is shown in dark brown and bronze, featuring a removable cap or chimney-holder with two side handles curving upward. The overall composition is clean and isolated, with no other objects or background details present.
title: Table Lamp
